text:
This long weariness will grow greater one day,
and the soul will tell the body it will not go on
dragging its weight along the rosy road
where men go, glad to be alive…


You will feel them digging vigorously beside you,
feel another sleeper come to the quiet city.
I will wait until they have covered me completely…
and then we will speak for all eternity!


Only then will you know why your flesh,
not yet ripe for the deep graves,
had to come down, without weariness, to sleep.
Light will break in the dark region of destinies:
you will know our bond bore a sign from the stars,
and, the great pact broken, you had to die…

translation.title: This Long Weariness
